name_en: Yamanashi katsudon — sauce-topped cutlet on cabbage and rice, no egg
summary_ja: ごはんに千切りキャベツをのせ、揚げたてのとんかつをソースでいただく山梨のかつ丼。卵でとじる一般的なかつ丼は地元で「煮かつ丼」と呼ばれ別物とされ、甲府市の老舗そば店が発祥と伝わる。
summary_en: Shredded cabbage sits under a freshly fried pork cutlet doused in sauce, no egg in sight — Yamanashi's version of katsudon. The egg-topped style found elsewhere is locally called 'ni-katsudon' and considered a different dish, this one said to have originated at an old Kofu soba shop.
source_title: かつ丼 山梨県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
